steps.title: Access thermal fuse
steps.body: Remove toe panel. Electric: fuse in series with drive motor. Gas: fuse in series with gas valve. See Figure 11.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove toe panel. Electric: fuse in series with drive motor. Gas: fuse in series with gas valve. See Figure 11.

steps.title: Thermal fuse continuity
steps.body: With ohmmeter on thermal fuse terminals: does the fuse show continuity (0 Ω)? Open circuit = failed fuse.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Replace failed thermal fuse.
